sources.title: Using module spider
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: ReFrame 效能回歸：正確性門檻與容許退化
related.titleEn: ReFrame regression: correctness gates and tolerated slowdown
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：載入與卸載皆可預期，未驗證配對保持不可用。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Load/unload behavior is predictable and unverified pairs remain unavailable.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「ReFrame 效能回歸：正確性門檻與容許退化」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付測試契約、輸出樣本、門檻推導與正負回歸案例。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct ReFrame regression: correctness gates and tolerated slowdown with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver test contracts, sample output, threshold derivation and positive/negative regression cases.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將三個有效配對各展開三個app版本，逐一編號。
把100與88放入同單位表，計下降量與相對值。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Expand each of three valid pairs into three app versions and number each environment.
Place 100 and 88 in matching-unit columns and calculate absolute and relative drops.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenTelemetry 分散式追蹤：取樣成本與稀有事件
related.titleEn: OpenTelemetry tracing: sampling cost and rare events
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：載入與卸載皆可預期，未驗證配對保持不可用。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Load/unload behavior is predictable and unverified pairs remain unavailable.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「OpenTelemetry 分散式追蹤：取樣成本與稀有事件」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付trace樹、取樣預算、遺漏原因和稀有錯誤保留策略。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct OpenTelemetry tracing: sampling cost and rare events with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver trace trees, sampling budgets, missing-span causes and rare-error retention policies.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將三個有效配對各展開三個app版本，逐一編號。
由每trace4000 bytes乘10000再乘10%，分別寫完整與抽樣資料流。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Expand each of three valid pairs into three app versions and number each environment.
Multiply 4000 bytes per trace by 10000 and 10%, listing full and sampled rates.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
